name: Codenames
summary: Two teams race to identify their secret agents from a grid of codenames using one-word clues from their spymasters.
rules_text: A 5x5 grid of 25 random word cards is dealt. A random key card, seen only by the two spymasters, assigns each grid position as red agent, blue agent, bystander, or assassin. Teams divide into red and blue, each with one spymaster. Teams alternate turns. On a turn, the spymaster gives a single-word clue that is not on the board and a number. The number indicates how many of their team's words relate to the clue. Operatives then discuss and make up to number+1 guesses, touching one word card at a time. If they reveal their color, they continue. If bystander, turn ends. If opponent's agent, it is covered for opponent and turn ends. If assassin, guessing team loses immediately. First team to cover all its agents wins.
rating_reason: Codenames is perfect: teams, hidden roles, free-text clue, voting, arithmetic scoring
